brief: A seven-cell honeycomb work surface, covered on top, with every open outside edge finished with caps.

requirements.evidence: 7x full hex bases at 0,0,0 center + 6 neighbors (1,0,0; 0,1,0; -1,1,0; -1,0,0; 0,-1,0; 1,-1,0) forming classic honeycomb
7 top covers: cover:-1,0,0; cover:-1,1,0; cover:0,-1,0; cover:0,0,0; cover:0,1,0; cover:1,-1,0; cover:1,0,0

requirements.requirement: Every open outside edge finished with caps
requirements.evidence: 18 caps placed on all perimeter outward faces (3 caps per outer hex, 6*3=18); check_build ok mesh clear, no cap errors

finish.summary: Built 7-cell honeycomb (center + 6 ring), added full top covers to all 7 cells, and capped all 18 exterior perimeter edges. Mesh clash clear.
